@@ -237,6 +237,14 @@ mod SelfhostDecl do
       PT(ret, after) -> finish_sig(pb, name, inside, ret, after)
     end
   end
+  # an UNTYPED clause with a multi-statement block body: `def f(pats) <nl> stmts end`
+  # (no `:=`, no return type — the dominant form for a multi-clause function's
+  # clauses). Collect the block to its matching `end` and parse its statements.
+  def classify_def(pb, name, inside, [TNL | rest])
+    case take_block(rest, 1, []) do
+      BRes(block, after) -> DR(DClause(name, parse_pats(inside), BlockE(parse_stmts(block))), after)
+    end
+  end
   def classify_def(pb, name, inside, after) := DR(DErr, after)
 
   # after the return type comes an optional `forall T, U: Bound` binder list, then

@@ -298,7 +298,13 @@ defmodule Rian.DeclFixpointTest do
     # `case` expressions — literal/var/wildcard arms, with and without a `when` guard
     "def classify(n Int64) Int64 := case n do
  0 -> 100
  _ -> n * 2
end",
     "def sgn(n Int64) Int64 := case n do
  0 -> 0
  m when m > 0 -> 1
  _ -> -1
end",
-    "def ctor(s Sign) Int64 := case s do
  Pos -> 1
  Neg -> -1
end"
+    "def ctor(s Sign) Int64 := case s do
  Pos -> 1
  Neg -> -1
end",
+    # UNTYPED clause + block body (`def f(p) <nl> stmts end`) — the dominant
+    # selfhost_decl idiom (a bodiless DSig followed by block-bodied clauses), which
+    # the parser previously rejected (DErr). Bind+expr blocks and a case block.
+    "def inc(n Int64) Int64
def inc(n)
  d := n + 1
  d
end",
+    "def cls(n Int64) Int64
def cls(n)
  case n do
    0 -> 100
    _ -> n
  end
end",
+    "def hd(xs Vec(Int64), d Int64) Int64
def hd([], d)
  d
end
def hd([h | _], d)
  h
end"
   ]
 
   defp norm_mod(m), do: %{m | funcs: Enum.map(m.funcs, &norm_func/1)}
